reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes depositing cryptocurrency into CMB as passive income with a stated return of 0.6% to 1.2% per day, while directing viewers to register, deposit $500, and follow the creator's step-by-step system. It also encourages recruitment by presenting referral growth, team-building, copied promotional assets, and future affiliate income as part of the process, making the solicitation materially more than an ordinary crypto demonstration.

citations.quote: this specific income stream pays between 0.6 and 1.2 percent per day
I'm showing you a proven step by step method to making passive income with cryptocurrency
we're going to do an amount of 500
complete step 1 and step 2 below and get started with CMB
upload the videos that I tell you to upload so you too can start building your team in CMb following my proven methodologies

opening.argument: The presentation expressly limits what viewers should infer. The creator says the results shown do not determine what viewers will achieve, and the accompanying disclosure states that earnings are not guaranteed and that this is not financial advice. Those warnings frame the material as a personal account with material uncertainty, rather than a promise that depositing will produce a particular outcome. The description also openly discloses that affiliate links may generate a small commission, allowing viewers to account for the speaker’s incentive instead of concealing it.

citations.quote: that doesn't dictate that you're going to create the same exact results
There is no guarantee that you will earn any money using the techniques and ideas mentioned in this video.
This is not financial advice.
This video and description may contain affiliate links, which means that if you click on one of the product links, I’ll receive a small commission.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing account treats the stated percentage as a guarantee, but the speaker expressly says viewers will not necessarily achieve the same results, while the description says earnings are not guaranteed. The disclosed affiliate relationship is also presented openly, which undercuts any claim that the incentive is hidden. These qualifications matter when deciding whether the material deceptively certifies an outcome.

citations.quote: that doesn't dictate that you're going to create the same exact results
There is no guarantee that you will earn any money using the techniques and ideas mentioned in this video.
I’ll receive a small commission

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer does not erase the affirmative promotion. The same material tells viewers that the income stream pays between 0.6 and 1.2 percent per day and instructs them to complete steps and get started. Saying outcomes are not guaranteed may reduce legal certainty, but it does not make a highly specific recurring-return pitch non-promotional.

citations.quote: this specific income stream pays between 0.6 and 1.2 percent per day
complete step 1 and step 2 below and get started with CMB
CMB is known as coin market bull and pays up to 1.2% per day in crypto passive income.

opening.argument: The content is structured as an operational walkthrough of the creator’s own crypto activity. He calls it day two of a challenge, explains the sequence viewers should follow, navigates the deposit workflow, swaps USDC for USDT, and shows the resulting transaction status. The sampled frames likewise show dashboard, wallet, swap, and payment pages with the speaker’s webcam overlay. That is consistent with a tutorial or personal demonstration: viewers are being shown how a process works, not given independent proof that an investment outcome is certain.

citations.quote: welcome to day two of my 0-10k challenge with cryptocurrency and creating passive income with crypto
what we're going to be doing in this video is we will be making a larger deposit today
we're going to trade in some USDC for USDT

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the video a walkthrough does not change its demonstrated subject: the creator tells viewers to complete the steps, make a deposit, and follow the same process. A tutorial can still promote the service it teaches. The operational detail therefore supports solicitation as much as demonstration.

citations.quote: all you guys need to do is make sure that you watch the CMSB overview video and deposit video below
step of course, number two, is to make your deposit
complete step 1 and step 2 below and get started with CMB

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The walkthrough is not neutral instruction about generic wallet use. It identifies a particular income stream, states its daily return range, directs viewers to CMB materials, and ends with a deposit instruction. Demonstrating the transfer is evidence of how to participate in that promoted program, not merely an abstract technical lesson.

citations.quote: this specific income stream pays between 0.6 and 1.2 percent per day
step of course, number two, is to make your deposit
get started with CMB

opening.argument: The available material can be read as promotion of a named crypto service and its referral program, with the commercial incentive disclosed. It does not establish that the service is fraudulent, that deposits are guaranteed to return principal, or that a particular recruitment structure is required for payment. The creator describes an affiliate commission and a personal deposit, while the frames show a branded dashboard and transaction workflow. Those facts support ordinary service promotion and a demonstration of purchasing or funding activity, without independently proving a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: This video and description may contain affiliate links, which means that if you click on one of the product links, I’ll receive a small commission.
we're going to do an amount of 500

rebuttal.rebuttal: The service is not presented like an ordinary retail purchase. The pitch centers on a recurring daily percentage, a crypto deposit, and building a team through copied videos. Whether the destination is independently proven fraudulent is beside the point when the video itself solicits participation in an investment-style income scheme.

citations.quote: this specific income stream pays between 0.6 and 1.2 percent per day
This is the same exact formula that I've used to build multiple six and even seven figure businesses.
upload the videos that I tell you to upload so you too can start building your team

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The material goes beyond ordinary affiliate marketing: it pairs a specified daily return with a required crypto deposit and instructs viewers to build a team using supplied videos. The absence of an explicit guarantee or independently proven fraud does not negate the investment solicitation or the recruitment mechanism shown in the speaker’s own instructions.
